slack.settings.title: Slack translation settings
slack.settings.desc: Applies to both the modal and the separate Slack window. Changes save right away.
slack.settings.model.heading: Translation model
slack.settings.model.pinnedDesc: A model used only to translate Slack messages.
slack.settings.style.heading: Translation style
slack.settings.style.preciseDesc: Stays close to the original; suits technical docs and specs.
slack.settings.style.balancedDesc: More natural while keeping every key point.
slack.settings.lang.heading: Languages
slack.settings.terms.heading: Terminology
slack.settings.terms.keepDesc: E.g. numbering (採番). Off translates the meaning only; people and company names stay in their original script.
slack.settings.terms.glossaryDesc: One pair per line: 日本語 = translation. The model always uses exactly this translation.
slack.settings.terms.placeholder:
採番 = numbering
